author: Ariadne I
title: Replication-Extend: FourierForecasterLN (rank_k=320, proj_rank=40) + Adam + Clip(1.0)
abstract: Capacity sweep of FourierForecasterLN by increasing proj_rank to 40 (from 32) to test representational headroom in the frequency-domain forecaster. Optimizer and loss match ID 335: Adam with clip=1.0; MAE + curvature (λ=1e-4).
